emergency_access_requests_fixed_ttl_chec.name: emergency_access_requests_fixed_ttl_check
emergency_access_requests_fixed_ttl_chec.value: "emergency_access_requests"."status" <> 'granted' or ("emergency_access_requests"."granted_at" is not null and "emergency_access_requests"."expires_at" = "emergency_access_requests"."granted_at" + interval '30 minutes')

emergency_access_reviews_decision_state_.name: emergency_access_reviews_decision_state_check
emergency_access_reviews_decision_state_.value: ("emergency_access_reviews"."reviewer_user_id" is null and "emergency_access_reviews"."outcome" is null and "emergency_access_reviews"."reviewed_at" is null) or ("emergency_access_reviews"."reviewer_user_id" is not null and "emergency_access_reviews"."outcome" is not null and "emergency_access_reviews"."reviewed_at" is not null)

emergency_access_reviews_escalation_stat.name: emergency_access_reviews_escalation_state_check
emergency_access_reviews_escalation_stat.value: ("emergency_access_reviews"."escalated_to_user_id" is null and "emergency_access_reviews"."escalated_at" is null) or ("emergency_access_reviews"."escalated_to_user_id" is not null and "emergency_access_reviews"."escalated_at" is not null and "emergency_access_reviews"."escalated_to_user_id" is distinct from "emergency_access_reviews"."reviewer_user_id")

notification_email_outbox_terminal_state.name: notification_email_outbox_terminal_state_check
notification_email_outbox_terminal_state.value: not ("notification_email_outbox"."sent_at" is not null and "notification_email_outbox"."failed_at" is not null)
